properties.rationale: User (who:ajs, standing policy from 2026-07-23, applied again 2026-07-25): validation happens through the trials programme — docs/trials/ is where "built the right thing" is exercised against operational intent; formal validation-kind Verification nodes are not this project's tracking mechanism. Re-fired because cap:mirror-surface joined the set (46 → 47). The trial is now unusually concrete and unusually available: reflow2 and storyflow are two separately-owned designs on one machine, which is exactly the split option (c) describes, so publishing one's surface and mirroring it into the other tests composition on real designs rather than a seven-node fixture. What no test can establish is whether the SEAM was drawn in the right place — a boundary that turns out to carry the wrong contract shows up as constant renegotiation, and only two owners using it discover that.
